build_uco3d_frame_data: build a UCO3DFrameData object from frame and sequence annotations with configurable modality loaders
create_ucode3d_frame_data_builder: create a UCO3DFrameDataBuilder instance with dataset root and modality load switches for 3D vision data
load_point_cloud_from_path: load a point cloud from a file path with optional caching and empty fallback support
load_gaussian_splats_from_dir: load compressed 3D gaussian splats from a directory with higher-order harmonics and background truncation
extract_frame_from_video: extract an RGB frame from a video file at a given timestamp using OpenCV video capture with caching
